testMethod.description: After the unchanged settlement engine captured the first authorization and persisted CAPTURED in the fixture ledger, the fixture harness voided the second authorization at the next provider-read boundary. The engine observed actual VOIDED state, entered compensation and fully refunded the first capture. No mock response header was used in this successful recovery test.

limits: This is an intentionally induced external authorization invalidation race, not natural expiration and not a verified AUTHORIZATION_EXPIRED mock response.
The original application database was unchanged; this is actual provider recovery exercised by an isolated in-memory fixture, not a browser end-to-end recovery sequence.
The earlier successful browser capture batch was preserved. The result proves one synchronous Sandbox recovery sequence, not every provider or operational failure.
redaction: Credential values, buyer identity, merchant identifiers, payment and batch identifiers, owner hashes and recovery snapshots are omitted.
